name: What common challenges might arise with a sale-leaseback agreement?

mainEntity.name: What common challenges might arise with a sale-leaseback agreement?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common challenges in a sale-leaseback agreement include negotiating agreeable rental terms, defining maintenance responsibilities, and ensuring the buyer's eventual move-in plans align with your exit timeline. Disagreements can arise if lease terms are not clearly defined or if unexpected repairs are needed. Having clear contractual language covering these aspects, with our guidance, is essential to prevent future disputes. We prioritize thorough agreement drafting to protect our clients' interests.
acceptedAnswer.description: Challenges with sale-leasebacks often involve negotiating rental terms, maintenance responsibilities, and coordinating move-out dates, all requiring clear contractual language.
